sections.name: Soups & Chili
items: Every day we have three or more homemade soups made with the freshest ingredients available. The soup menu changes daily and seasonally; Tomato Florentine and New England Clam Chowder are on the menu year-round, Gazpacho and Summer Berry are available during the warmer months.

Our traditional beef chili is made in-house using a slow-cook method that allows the spices and flavors to be fully absorbed into the ingredients. Topped with tortilla chips, cheddar cheese & chopped scallions.
